description: A sprite sheet of FOUR separate antique fantasy RPG user interface pieces arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each centered in its own quarter, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, perfectly symmetrical: top-left a square window frame made of dark carved wood with ornate aged gold metal corner pieces and a thin gold inner trim, HOLLOW with an empty center; top-right a small square inventory slot frame of dark stone with tiny gold rivets at the corners, HOLLOW with an empty center; bottom-left a wide rectangular button made of a polished wooden plank with aged gold trim and gold end caps; bottom-right a horizontal parchment scroll title banner with rolled ends, thick dark outline, every piece fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background that also fills the hollow centers, no text, no icons, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm aged wood and stone palette. Do not draw this house.
